hero_eyebrow: Local Landscape Specialist — Southampton & Surrounding Areas
hero_subhead: Professional landscape design and gardening in Southampton. From small patios to large garden overhauls, we create outdoor spaces you'll love.
services_heading: Complete Landscape & Garden Services in Southampton
services_subhead: From design and build to ongoing maintenance, we handle every aspect of creating and caring for your outdoor space.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke garden design tailored to your home and lifestyle. We listen to your ideas, assess your space, and create a plan that works for your budget and vision.

services.title: Patio & Hardscaping
services.desc: Professional installation of patios, decking, pathways, and boundary walls. Durable materials, clean workmanship, and designs that blend with your home.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Expert planting schemes using seasonal colour, shrubs, and perennials. We choose plants suited to your soil and light conditions for low-maintenance impact.

services.title: Lawn Care & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular grass cutting, feeding, scarification, and aeration to keep your lawn healthy and green. Monthly or seasonal visits tailored to your needs.

services.title: Hedge & Tree Care
services.desc: Professional hedge trimming, tree pruning, and felling with full waste removal. Safe, tidy work carried out to industry standards.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Cleanup
services.desc: Complete garden clearance including overgrown areas, old structures, and waste removal. A blank canvas to start your garden transformation.

about_pullquote: Every garden tells a story. We help yours tell the right one.
about_para_1: U 4 Davies was founded on a simple belief: that every homeowner deserves a garden they're proud of, without the stress or guesswork. Over 18 years, we've worked across Southampton and beyond, transforming tired, neglected outdoor spaces into havens for families and wildlife alike. Our owner takes personal pride in every project—whether it's a small tidy-up or a complete garden redesign.
about_para_2: We're known locally for listening carefully to what our customers want, delivering on time, and leaving every garden spotless. Many of our clients come back year after year for seasonal maintenance because they know we'll protect their investment and keep their garden looking its best. That's trust earned through genuine care and expert know-how.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. The lads turned our overgrown back garden into something really special. They explained everything clearly, stuck to the timeline, and left the place immaculate. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had U 4 Davies do a complete redesign and it's transformed the whole feel of our home. They listened to what we wanted, made helpful suggestions, and the quality of work is obvious. We've had them back for maintenance since and wouldn't use anyone else.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Quick to respond, competitive pricing, and they know their plants. Our new borders have filled in beautifully and the lawn has never looked better. Very professional outfit.
reviews.author: Richard P.
